features.name: log_income_to_loan_ratio
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of person's income to the loan amount, capturing the applicant's capacity to repay the principal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth, scaled measure of financial capacity, which helps linear models establish a clear decision boundary based on relative income.

features.name: debt_burden_index
features.description: Interaction between the percentage of income dedicated to the loan and the interest rate, representing the ongoing financial strain.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an explicit interaction term for linear SVMs, combining two critical risk factors into a single continuous severity measure.

features.name: credit_score_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalized credit score to ensure it is on a similar scale to other features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scaling prevents the large magnitude of credit scores from dominating the SVM margin calculations.

features.name: employment_stability_ratio
features.description: Ratio of employment experience to adult age, indicating long-term job stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes employment length by age, providing a more comparable stability metric across different age groups for linear projections.

features.name: loan_risk_composite
features.description: Composite score combining the log of the loan amount and the scaled interest rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a weighted composite of loan size and cost, allowing the linear model to easily separate high-cost, large loans.

features.name: credit_history_age_ratio
features.description: Ratio of credit history length to adult age, reflecting how early the applicant established credit.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a normalized view of credit maturity, which is more linearly separable than raw credit history length.

features.name: high_risk_profile_indicator
features.description: Indicator for applicants with both a low credit score and a high loan-to-income percentage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Introduces a non-linear threshold effect as a distinct feature, helping the linear SVM capture specific high-risk intersections.

features.name: income_adjusted_interest
features.description: Interest rate adjusted by the logarithm of the applicant's income.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous severity measure that penalizes high interest rates more heavily for lower-income applicants.

features.name: financial_vulnerability_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of the applicant's overall financial vulnerability based on income, employment experience, and home ownership status.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures nuanced financial stability signals that raw formulas might miss, providing a smooth continuous feature for the SVM.

features.name: loan_purpose_risk_alignment
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the inherent risk associated with the loan intent, contextualized by the applicant's education and credit history.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates categorical loan intents into an ordinal risk scale, which is highly effective for linear margin optimization.

features.name: previous_default_severity
features.description: Combines the presence of previous defaults with the current loan-to-income percentage to gauge compounded risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales a binary categorical feature by a continuous risk metric, creating a more informative feature for linear boundaries.

features.name: age_income_interaction
features.description: Log of income divided by age, representing the rate of wealth accumulation over time.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized earning power metric, helping the model differentiate between early-career and late-career income levels.
